Exam 1 is in class on **Wednesday, Oct 14**. It lasts **75 minutes** and you may use a **calculator** and **one handwritten notes sheet** (front and back). You will not write any code.

## Practice exam

The practice exam has the same format as the real exam and is worth 100 points. Print it and take it in one sitting, under timed conditions.

-   [{{< fa file-lines >}} Practice exam (web page)](https://ericfriedlander.github.io/math2025-fa26/ae/ae-12-exam01-practice.html)
